        buy Kurtis For Women

        Look Alluring with Beautiful Women's Kurtis from Myntra

        Well-fitted women's kurtis are a great starting piece when stepping into the wonderful world of Indian ethnic wear. Not only are the garments breathtakingly beautiful but come in a large variety of fabrics, thread work, prints, embellishments, designs and fits. You can style them to perfection without much effort. 

        Kurtas are the traditional garb of choice for both men and women in many parts of southern Asia, including Sri Lanka, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Nepal, etc. 'Kurta', in Persian, means a shirt without a collar. Although initially worn by men, it later became popular among women's fashion trends. Women's kurtas that have a shorter length took on a new name—Kurtis.

        Whether you like to stick to classic styles or experiment with bold, contemporary designs for a fusion look, Myntra's kurtis collection has it all, and more. Get your hands on the ultimate selection of women's ethnic wear online before stocks run out.

        Find the Perfect Style with Women’s Kurtis Collection Online

        Women from all over the country have worn Kurtis. Let us take a look at the styles you can grab on Myntra. 

      • Designer Kurtis- Kurtis are a multi-faceted clothing item and can be worn with anything, right from churidars and palazzos to leggings and jeans. Whether you love sporting cotton kurtis to work every day or are fond of silk, crepe, georgette or even wool variants for special occasions, is a matter of personal choice. Shop for hand and block printed pieces to embroidered items with beads, sequins and stones.
